title: Valencia: Oceanogràfic Entry Ticket
start: L'Oceanogràfic, City of Arts and Sciences
summary: General admission ticket with access to all exhibits; food and drinks not included.

title: Valencia: Essentials Walking Tour of 3 World Heritage Sites
start: Tourism Hub, Estació del Nord (Carrer de Xàtiva 24)
summary: Guided walk with entrance to the Silk Exchange and the City Hall, subject to opening.

title: Valencia: Old Town Tour, Wine & Tapas in an 11th c. Monument
summary: Guided old-town walk in English, then a full tasting menu of tapas, paella and dessert with wine.

title: Valencia: Paella Cooking Class with Central Market Tour
start: Covetes de los Santos Juanes, Plaça del Mercat 7
summary: Paella class with a chef, all ingredients, tapas, wine and dessert; the Central Market visit is on morning sessions Monday to Saturday only.

title: From Valencia: Albufera Natural Park with Sunset Boat Tour
summary: Return coach to the Albufera, a nature walk with a local guide and a sunset boat trip on the lake; food and drinks not included.

title: From Valencia: Guadalest, Altea & Algar Waterfalls Day Trip
summary: Return coach and guide, free time in Altea and Guadalest, and entry to the Algar Waterfalls; meals and Guadalest museums not included.
